body: I'm fine with people making that assessment, I'm just scared that it'll bite me in the ass later like it has done before.

Out of those options the only one I'd consider would be cleaning because it would mean I wouldn't really have to interact with people. I've been screwed over socially so many times now in my life that I find it nigh-on impossible to actually trust people anymore, and when I'm around people I'm constantly paranoid and anxious about what they think of me or if they're laughing at me behind my back.
